title: accompanying-documents — mandatory document metadata + sub-resource projection
recipe: sets/live-animals/docs/add-a-collection.md (documents single-page add-another loop exemplar, recipe cheat-sheet §4) + SIBLING-SET-PLAN.md §6.2/FD-11 for the records sub-resource projection (§8 G-D gap — no records-adapter recipe; §6.2's table plus this plan ARE the script for that part)

filesToTouch.what: Four obligation exports (SIBLING-SET-PLAN §3.1 documents.js row, fresh UUIDs, copy-free): `accompanyingDocuments` GROUP { id, name: 'accompanyingDocuments', requires: { minEntries: 1, errorCode: 'obligation.accompanyingDocuments.required' } } — no status, no applyTo (top-level user-driven group, always in scope; c-015 RULED MANDATORY ≥1 document, submit-blocking via collection-complete rollup); members all `within: accompanyingDocuments` (object identity import), all status 'mandatory': `documentType`, `documentReference`, `issueDate`. NO files/attachment obligation (bytes deferred to pp-051) and NO maxEntries cap (§3.1 declares only the floor — deviation from the live-animals 10-cap recorded in notes). Exemplar shape: sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/documents.js.

Import + re-export accompanyingDocuments, documentType, documentReference, issueDate from './sections/documents.js'; append all four to the `obligations` array. `groups` stays derived (never hand-kept); `policy` untouched (no systemPopulated/enforcedAtContinue/maxEntriesFrom membership for any of these).
Import-free page identity: exports `accompanyingDocumentsPage = { id: 'accompanying-documents', slug: 'accompanying-documents' }`.

Group descriptor `const document = { field: 'accompanyingDocuments', token: 'doc', obligation: accompanyingDocuments }`; exports `evaluationBindings = feature('documents', [...])` binding each leaf with grouped({ field, obligation, groups: [document] }): documentType, documentReference, issueDate. Depth-1 chain — binding depth must equal the within chain. Exemplar: sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/evaluation.js.

Single-page add-another loop controller (transpose the live-animals documents controller MINUS every upload/scan/client-JS concern — no uploadId/filename/attachment branch, no scan-poll, no webpack entry). `export const meta = { ...accompanyingDocumentsPage, collects: ['accompanyingDocuments'] }` (group root only — members inherit dispatch from the nearest ancestor group). GET: state.get() once, state.collectionView(answers, ['accompanyingDocuments']) → controller-built read-back rows (type label via documentTypeLabel(code) from '../../../../services/reference/document-types.js', reference, issue date rendered from the stored {day,month,year} value — same rendering approach as the live-animals documents view-model rows) + blank entry form. POST branches on the submit action: (1) action==='add' → read raw payload; entry = { documentType: (payload.documentType ?? '').trim(), documentReference: (payload.documentReference ?? '').trim(), issueDate: kit.readDate(payload, 'issueDate') }; validate single-layer Joi-voice (c-018, one canonical string per field): documentType required + must be a member of documentTypeOptions values (membership rule built inside POST from the reference module, never frozen in a module-level schema) → 'Select a document type'; documentReference required → 'Enter a reference', maxText 100 → 'Document reference must be 100 characters or fewer'; issueDate required (isBlank) → 'Enter a date of issue', dateText/dateParts calendar validity → 'Date of issue must be a real date'; invalid → re-render RAW values status 400 with GDS 'There is a problem' summary (error-summary hrefs #documentType / #documentReference / #issueDate matching input ids); valid → state.appendEntry(request, h, 'accompanyingDocuments', entry) wrapped in kit.recoverableSave, re-render the page (fresh blank row + new saved row). (2) action startsWith 'remove:' → parse index, look the instance up via collectionView first and REFUSE a forged/stale index (no write), else state.removeEntry(...) — submit-button action so the crumb travels, never a GET delete. (3) plain Continue → NO validation, NO write, redirect via await kit.nextTarget(request, page, scope) with kit.hubExitTarget winning first; the minEntries-1 floor bites at the task row/submit readiness, not at Continue (dissolves the legacy 'started row' rule — notes). All internal links/redirects wrapped in kit.withChangeContext. `export const routes = kit.pageRoutes(page, { get, post })` — kit.pageRoutes builds its path from the PREFIX-FREE route-shape builder (pageRoutePath) at module load and the `/plant-products` mount comes from the gateway's Hapi plugin prefix, while every rendered href, form action and redirect this controller emits (kit.nextTarget, kit.hubExitTarget, remove/add self-posts) resolves per request through the PREFIX-BEARING link builders — never hand-written paths.

notes: 1:1 carry of inc-025 with the c-015 ruling (MANDATORY ≥1 document) and ownership of the FD-11 sub-resource projection pp-008 deliberately stubbed with omission assertions — this increment flips those assertions from 'ignored' to 'projected/folded'. DESIGN TRANSPOSITION, not replication: the legacy page's fake div table, aria-label-only inputs, bespoke datepicker, link-button submits and 'started row' partial-validation rule are all replaced by the house single-page add-another loop (live-animals documents exemplar, recipe §4 'documents' layout) — the page spec's own govukAlternative column prescribes exactly this. Upload/attachment surface entirely absent (pp-051 deferred): no 'Add attachment', no files obligation, no client JS, hence no webpack entry (build-config rule not triggered). Reference max length 100 per the legacy-confirmed cap (live-animals uses 58 — plant follows its own page spec). HEADLESS DECISIONS: (1) no maxEntries cap — §3.1's documents row declares only the floor; flagged as open question rather than importing the live-animals 10-cap; (2) reconcile order = PUT document, then sub-resource replace, then re-GET + marshal so replaceFulfilment/load agree (one extra GET, acceptable at pass-1 volumes); (3) sub-resource document ids are NOT durable under naive replace — from-dto drops them (consistent with snapshot-local collection positions); pp-051 will need keyed reconcile when bytes attach to stable ids; (4) documentType allowlist enforced in the controller (POST-time membership rule from the reference module) not as a model allowListed gate — matches the live-animals documents exemplar where type validity is feature-side, keeps the manifest free of a gate with no answer dependency; (5) the phytosanitary inset warning ships as page copy (c-015's on-page statement) while the MODEL floor is any-document ≥1 — type-specific enforcement is NOT modelled (see open questions). Rulings applied: c-015 (mandatory ≥1), c-016 (Sea waybill dedupe via pp-016), c-018 (one canonical string, Joi voice), c-004/c-014 (GDS error summary, legend/label discipline, caption+H1), FD-11 (sub-resource projection detail owned here), D-19 (copy documentless — no reconcile change needed for copy), mirror-existing-frontend/no-gold-plating (loop page shape matches live-animals documents minus upload).
openQuestions: c-015 collapse: the ruling models the floor as ANY ≥1 document, but the legacy submit-time rule was specifically 'Add a phytosanitary certificate' (conditional on PHSI/JOINT commodity regulatory authority) plus a phytosanitary-attachment-required rule. Pass 1 enforces the plain minEntries-1 floor and states the phytosanitary need as inset-text copy only — confirm with product whether a documentType==='PHYTOSANITARY_CERTIFICATE'-specific readiness rule is wanted before/with pp-051 (attachment enforcement is impossible until bytes exist anyway).

No maxEntries cap declared (SIBLING-SET-PLAN §3.1 documents row has only the floor; the legacy page's cap is unobserved and its MAX_ATTACHMENTS=10 was per-attachment). Live-animals caps documents at 10 — should plant adopt the same cap for parity, or stay uncapped until product rules?

Backend acceptance of a documents POST with no files: SCHEMA-DESIGN's PlantProductsAccompanyingDocumentDto carries files[] — confirm (ideally in pp-004's PlantProductsAccompanyingDocumentIT) that an absent/empty files list is accepted with metadata-only bodies; if the backend requires the key, documentToDto sends files: [] (one-line change).

Naive replace churns sub-resource document ids on every save — harmless in pass 1 (ids are never surfaced to the frontend), but pp-051 must switch to a keyed reconcile before attachments bind bytes to ids; recorded here so the FD-11 'naive acceptable' ruling has an explicit expiry condition.

If product wants the long format, it is a one-line formatter in the read-back row builder — flagged, not decided, since the page spec itself lists the display format as unconfirmed.
